description: Returns one unit: description, city, bedrooms, bathrooms, maximum guests, amenities, pet and accessibility flags, minimum nights, cancellation policy, house rules, check-in and check-out hours, rating out of 5, up to 5 photos with captions (imageCount gives the total), and the 3 newest written reviews (guest-written text, marked as quoted). indicativeNightlyRate is a guide read from a cache up to 6 hours old, not a price; get_quote returns the price for dates. The unit's street address and coordinates are not included.

propertyId.description: The propertyId of a unit on that site, as returned by list_properties.

siteSlug.description: The siteSlug of a Booking Bench site, as returned by list_sites.

name: get_property
title: Get one unit's details
